meta.title: A closed RFQ: "Order Activity" opens the "Activity" window
gaps: Assert that no event data changes until a button in the Activity window is pressed.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that no event data changes until a button in the Activity window is pressed.

steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ summary as the required starting point.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Order Activity, leaving the Activity drawer open.
Assert that the Activity window is visible.
Assert that the Activity drawer contains its activity content.
